scope: Synthetic shared-module repair; not platform acceptance

children.name: Transactional stock contracts
children.description: Repair the supplied CommonJS modules. Preserve exports. All functions are pure: no input object or array may be mutated. No dependencies or frontend scaffolding. Keep package.json and acceptance.cjs byte-for-byte unchanged.

quantity(value) returns value only when it is a positive safe integer; otherwise throws RangeError. available(stock, sku) returns the own-property count for sku, or zero when absent; that count must be a nonnegative safe integer or it throws RangeError. Inherited properties are absent.

reserve(stock, items) returns a new stock object with requested quantities subtracted. Items have sku and quantity. Aggregate duplicate sku quantities before comparing with available stock. Reject insufficient stock or invalid quantity/count with RangeError. Missing stock is zero. A failure must not change any input, including prior items in the same batch. Empty items return a new equal object.

release(stock, items) returns a new stock object with each positive safe integer quantity added, aggregating repeated sku entries. A previously absent SKU starts at zero. Validate using the shared helpers; reject invalid counts, quantities or unsafe resulting sums with RangeError. Never change stock or items.

plan: Inspect the supplied related modules, repair their shared contracts coherently, and run the protected build and test scripts. Keep package.json and acceptance.cjs immutable. Use Node built-ins only. Finish once the fixed acceptance passes; do not add features or weaken validation.

files.package.json: {"name": "inventory-repair", "private": true, "scripts": {"build": "node --check src/quantity.cjs && node --check src/reserve.cjs && node --check src/release.cjs", "test": "node acceptance.cjs"}}
